We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented HR Recruiter to join our HR team. The candidate will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end recruitment process, from understanding manpower requirements and sourcing candidates to interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding.

title: Support Engineer
description:
You’re an excellent candidate for Bizzdesign because you …* Live in Chennai and can commute to the office 3\-4 days per week
* Speak fluent English and can explain technical concepts clearly
* Have 2\-4 years of SaaS application support experience and are willing to work flexible shifts to support customers across global time zones

  

  

**About the role**  

  

This role is designed to help customers successfully use and troubleshoot our software as their first point of contact for technical support.  

  

You will diagnose questions and challenges, dive into our Documentation and Knowledge Base (KB), and deliver fast, accurate solutions.  

  

When challenges get more complex, you’ll step in with clear, structured guidance and direct communication, and connect to customers live if required. If needed, you will escalate requests to our experts within the team or to R\&D teams to keep improving our platforms.
  

  

This role is part of our Customer Success organization and focuses on technical customer support and incident resolution.  

  

**What will you do**
* Support customers around the world in getting the most from our platforms
* Log and document incidents accurately in Jira to ensure clear ownership and follow\-up
* Use our Knowledge Base to troubleshoot efficiently and deliver faster solutions
* Share your expertise and insights to strengthen our internal knowledge
* Keep customers informed through proactive, transparent communication throughout the resolution process
* Collaborate with colleagues across our international team to resolve complex issues and continuously improve the customer experience

  

  

**What we are looking for**
* Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT or a related field
* Have 2–4 years of SaaS application support experience, with a strong understanding of IT systems and a structured troubleshooting approach
* Communicate clearly in English and simplify technical concepts for different audiences
* Bring a curious, solution\-oriented approach to troubleshooting
* Are willing to work flexible or rotating shifts across global time zones
* Have experience debugging APIs and SQL, including REST, JSON, authentication methods, and basic queries
* Have experience with Windows Server/IIS, SQL Server, and/or Linux systems, including basic commands and troubleshooting, with an awareness of ITIL practices
* Programming skills are a plus

  

  

**What success looks like after 12 months**
* You're confidently owning customer issues from first contact through to resolution, providing a smooth and reassuring experience every step of the way.
* You can quickly diagnose and resolve configuration, integration, and platform challenges, becoming a go\-to expert for complex technical questions.
* You've made a lasting impact by sharing your knowledge and contributing valuable content to our Knowledge Base.
* Customers and colleagues trust your expertise and regularly turn to you for technical guidance and advice.
* You're working closely with Product and R\&D teams, helping shape product improvements through customer insights and real\-world experience.

  

  

**What we offer**
* A competitive salary complemented by variable compensation.
* Company\-sponsored Provident Fund and Gratuity benefits in line with local regulations.
* 15 vacation days during your first two years, 20 vacation days in years three and four, and 25 vacation days from your fifth year onwards.
* Hybrid working that truly works: enjoy a balance of 3\-4 collaborative in\-office days, with the remaining days designed for focused work from home.
* A health insurance plan designed to support your wellbeing and give you peace of mind.
* Premium IT equipment from day one, plus a personal technology budget to help you create a workspace that suits your needs.
* The opportunity to collaborate with colleagues, customers, and partners across the globe in a truly international environment.
* A culture built on trust, autonomy, and ownership, where your ideas are valued, and your contribution makes a visible impact.

  

  

**Recruitment process**  

  

In this role, you can expect the following interviewing process:* 1st Interview with Internal Recruiter (45 minutes)
* 2nd Interview with our Senior Support Manager (60 minutes)
* 3rd Interview with a Support Engineer (60 minutes)

The Talent Acquisition Manager will play a key role in enabling business growth by attracting and bringing in the right talent to support current and future business needs. Reporting to the Head of TAA, the role will be expected to work closely with business and HR stakeholders to understand evolving talent requirements and translate these into effective sourcing and hiring strategies.


The Talent Acquisition Manager will provide market insights, sourcing expertise and strategic hiring support to deliver high\-quality hiring outcomes across multiple functions and geographies. The role will also be expected to enhance the candidate experience, support diversity hiring ambitions and contribute to employer branding initiatives that strengthen Maersk’s ability to attract and engage the right talent.


**What You Can Expect:**

* Deliver timely and high\-quality hiring outcomes through effective sourcing and talent attraction strategies.

* Build and nurture talent pipelines through relevant hiring communities, professional networks, industry forums, and events.
* Leverage market insights and talent intelligence to advise stakeholders on talent availability, competitor landscapes, and hiring trends.
* Support and advocate diversity hiring initiatives to help achieve Maersk's diversity and inclusion ambitions.
* Contribute to employer branding and talent attraction initiatives that enhance Maersk's visibility and reputation as an employer of choice.
* Utilize innovative sourcing approaches and candidate engagement strategies to identify and attract top talent.

title: Senior HR Recruiter
description:
**Job Title:** Senior HR Recruiter

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Kurumbapalayam, coimbatore

**Position Summary:**

The Senior HR Recruiter is responsible for leading full\-cycle recruitment processes to attract and hire top talent across all departments. This role partners closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand workforce needs, develop sourcing strategies, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience. The ideal candidate will be proactive, data\-driven, and skilled at both strategic planning and hands\-on execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates.
* Collaborate with department heads to **understand hiring needs** and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Utilize multiple sourcing channels (LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, networks, etc.) to **identify and attract top talent**.
* Build and maintain a **strong talent pipeline** for critical and recurring roles.
* Conduct **competency\-based interviews** and coordinate technical and final interviews with hiring panels.
* Partner with HR and hiring managers to **define job descriptions and role requirements**.
* Ensure a **positive candidate experience** throughout the recruitment process.
* Analyze **recruitment metrics** (time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, quality of hire) and present regular reports to management.
* Stay up to date on **industry trends and best practices** in recruitment and employer branding.
* Support **diversity and inclusion initiatives** in hiring practices.
* Mentor and guide junior recruiters or HR associates as needed.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* **5–8 years of experience** in recruitment or talent acquisition ( preferred school or college is added advantages)
* Proven experience managing **high\-volume and specialized recruitment**.
* Strong knowledge of **ATS platforms** and HR software (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse, Lever).
* Excellent **communication and negotiation skills**.
* Demonstrated ability to **build relationships** with stakeholders at all levels.
* Data\-driven mindset with experience in **recruitment analytics and reporting**.
* Strong understanding of **labor laws and HR best practices**.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking and planning
* Stakeholder management
* Decision\-making and problem\-solving
* Adaptability and time management
* Confidentiality and integrity
